ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde Trust & Safety: review the driver's threatening chat message against the Code of Conduct (possible account suspension/reporting), and separately review the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee; rider to be contacted and the fee refunded as a voucher if the no-show is not substantiated + flag_account
ruling.escalation_reason: Driver sent an intimidation message in-app ("Hurry up or I will find you and you will regret it."), which is a threat/intimidation keyword under SAFE-1; dispute therefore goes to a human reviewer (no automated ruling). Separately, the driver's no-show assertion is not supported by the system records — GPS shows the driver was ~0.68 km (≈680 m) east of the Bugis Junction pickup for the whole wait, far outside the 200 m arrival radius — so if a human upholds the fee side, the $6.61 cancellation fee should be refunded and the driver's account flagged for abuse of the cancellation/waiting-fee flow.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver statement ('waited more than 4 minutes... cancelled as a no-show') is not verified here: the wait was 3 min 40 s from 'I'm Here' (09:50:45) to cancellation (09:54:25), and GPS places the driver ~0.68 km east of the Bugis Junction pickup at 09:47:00 with the pressed-here fix ~55–60 m off; NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) cannot be confirmed from the record, and NS-2 would require full refund of the $6.61 if (ii) fails. Left to human review given the SAFE-1 trigger.
